decisions.title: Sunport Commerce Center Design Overlay Zone
decisions.description: Establishes the adopted design overlay for Sunport Commerce Center, coordinating land use, multimodal circulation, street and block design, access, parking, landscaping, signage, architecture, drainage, utilities, and development review around the airport employment district.
decisions.provenance_status: official County Transportation Plans library and byte-identical County-hosted file recorded
processing_notes: Original authoritative 60-page PDF preserved without modification.
Exact size and SHA-256 recorded; representative first, middle, and final pages were rendered and visually reviewed.
The overlay was adopted by the County Commission on May 14, 2019; the final file is dated June 27, 2019.

decisions.title: Juan Tabo Boulevard Connectivity Study — Virtual Public Meeting 1
decisions.description: Documents the first Juan Tabo Connectivity Study public meeting, presenting study limits, property and environmental constraints, traffic and crash conditions, cut-through data, and five roadway alternatives before the City gathered community feedback.
decisions.provenance_status: official City Council project page and byte-identical City-hosted file recorded
processing_notes: Original authoritative 29-page presentation preserved without modification.
Exact size and SHA-256 recorded; representative first, middle, and final slides were rendered and visually reviewed.
Preserved as planning-process history supporting the final 2021 connectivity study.

decisions.title: Juan Tabo Boulevard Connectivity Study — Virtual Public Meeting 2
decisions.description: Documents public and stakeholder feedback, compares connectivity alternatives across traffic, safety, right-of-way, cost, development, bio-zone, and landfill impacts, and explains why no-build ranked highest while a bridge option was estimated near $36 million.
decisions.provenance_status: official City Council project page and byte-identical City-hosted file recorded
processing_notes: Original authoritative 34-page presentation preserved without modification.
Exact size and SHA-256 recorded; representative first, middle, and final slides were rendered and visually reviewed.
The official page labels this Virtual Meeting 2; the presentation followed the December 1, 2020 meeting and preceded the February 2, 2021 comment deadline.

decisions.title: Juan Tabo Hills Traffic Study — Public Meeting Presentation
decisions.description: Presents the Juan Tabo Hills study’s crash, speed, traffic-volume, pedestrian, bicycle, transit, and intersection findings, then evaluates turn lanes, roundabouts, continuous-flow intersections, access management, multimodal connections, crossing treatments, and traffic-calming options.
decisions.provenance_status: official City Council project page and byte-identical City-hosted file recorded
processing_notes: Original authoritative 33-page presentation preserved without modification.
Exact size and SHA-256 recorded; representative first, middle, and final slides were rendered and visually reviewed.
Preserved as the September 20, 2022 public-facing baseline and alternatives presentation supporting the final 2023 traffic study.
